schema.description: One keyset page of labour plans of a (site, shift), ordered by path id.

shift_start.description: Absent when the plan was committed without one.

heads_source.description: request when planned_heads was sent; forecast when it was derived from the workload forecast.

version.description: 1 for a first commit, + 1 per commit that changed the plan.

warnings.description: Advisory, computed against the facility tally on every read (never stored, never null): a warning when the tally knows fewer stations of the activity named like the path than installed_stations. The number is reported as sent, never replaced.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; absent on the last page.

schema.title: LabourPlanPage

400.description: site_id or shift_id missing (missing-site-id, missing-shift-id), or invalid-limit, invalid-cursor, unknown-query-parameter.

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
